name: Greek Salad Bowl with Tzatziki & Baked Meatballs (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 3 medium, 3 small, and 3 mini food storage containers.
Preheat oven to 450°F. Coat a large baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 English cucumber
1 small bunch fresh dill
1 lemon
1 pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.

Peel and mince garlic and shallot. Add both to the bowl with the parsley along with beef, egg, almond flour, and spices. Using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the mixture into meatballs, then transfer to the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
garlic
3 shallot
1 lb lean ground beef
1 egg
3 tbsp almond meal/flour
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until meatballs are golden and cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, trim and coarsely grate half of the cucumber. Use paper towels or a clean cloth to squeeze excess moisture out of the grated cucumber. Place in a clean medium bowl. (Reserve remaining cucumber for later use.)
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Zest and juice lemon into the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl, along with yogurt and salt, then stir to combine the tzatziki. Divide between the mini food storage containers and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
garlic
⅔ cup plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter remaining cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in another medium bowl.
Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.

Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers crosswise into thin rounds. Peel and slice additional shallots crosswise into thin rounds. Add both to the bowl along with feta, olives, oil, and oregano, then stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (4 oz) pkg crumbled feta cheese
½ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp oregano, dried

instructions.primary_message: Divide salad and tzatziki between the medium storage containers, then cover and refrigerate. Divide meatballs between the small storage containers and allow to cool completely, about 20 minutes. Once cool, cover containers and refrigerate. When ready to eat, heat the meatballs in the oven or microwave. Enjoy with the salad and tzatziki!
